title: Robust Federated Edge Training with Chunked Secure Transfer and Heartbeat-Driven Reliability Management
authors: Nilesh S. Sanyasi — Lead AI Engineer & Founder, Applied Sentience Labs
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving collaborative training across distributed edge devices, but production deployments encounter critical operational challenges including unreliable connectivity, concurrent socket access races, and inefficient large-model transfers. This paper presents FET (Federated Edge Training), a production-grade FL framework addressing these challenges through heartbeat-driven liveness tracking, race-free socket lifecycle management, and authenticated chunked model transfer.
